```{r include-extended, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
src_file <- "
30-sequential-mixture-experimentation.md
"
# Find the package root by walking up from getwd() until DESCRIPTION is found
pkg_root <- getwd()
while (pkg_root != dirname(pkg_root)) {
  if (file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "DESCRIPTION"))) break
  pkg_root <- dirname(pkg_root)
}
src <- file.path(pkg_root, "inst", "monographs", src_file)
if (nzchar(src) && file.exists(src)) {
  cat(readLines(src, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("**Extended tutorial not found.**\n")
}
```
